sloka: समाप्तकर्मा हि स राक्षसाधिपो भवत्यदृस्यः समरे सुरासुरैः।युयुत्सता तेन समाप्तकर्मणा भवेत् सुराणामपि संशयो महान् ।। ६.८४.२२ ।।
transliteration: samāptakarmā hi sa rākṣasādhipo bhavatyadṛsyaḥ samare surāsuraiḥ।yuyutsatā tena samāptakarmaṇā bhavet surāṇāmapi saṁśayo mahān ।। 6.84.22 ।।

translations.english: 'O best of men, delay is not proper in the slaying of the foe — what can be done today, do. Loose your arrow-power for the destruction of the enemy, as the great Indra did in crushing the city of the asuras.'
